Smarter protection for everyday spending

Stop fraud.
Keep your access.

Fraud protection should stop the threat, not your day. SmartShield helps keep real purchases moving and your money within reach.

The problem and why it matters

Valid purchases get blocked. Fraud gets through. Replacement cards take days.

Each failure disrupts access to money, damages customer trust, or creates losses for the bank.

1

Valid purchases are blocked.

The problem: A legitimate purchase is mistakenly flagged as fraud and declined at checkout.

Who experiences it: Debit customers.

Why it matters: The customer cannot finish the purchase, disrupting an ordinary day.

CustomerCheckout interrupted
2

Fraudulent purchases go through.

The problem: An unauthorized purchase is approved when fraud detection misses it.

Who experiences it: Both customer and bank.

Why it matters: Customers lose trust in the bank, while fraudulent spending can cause financial loss.

Customer + bankTrust and money at risk
3

Replacement cards arrive too slowly.

The problem: A physical replacement card can take five days or more to arrive after fraud.

Who experiences it: Debit customers.

Why it matters: Without a usable debit card, the customer may be unable to make debit purchases while waiting.

CustomerFive or more days waiting

Our proposed solution

SmartShield AI learns how you spend to protect your money and keep your day moving.

The goal is simple: protect customers' funds without adding unnecessary disruption to their lives.

1 · Decision every transaction

Check every purchase. Ask when something looks unusual.

Our SmartShield AI decision engine reviews every purchase. When a purchase looks unusual, the customer receives an in-app request to confirm or decline it.

  • ✓ YesThe legitimate purchase continues without disruption.
  • ✕ NoThe fraudulent purchase is blocked, and recovery begins.
2 · Restore access

Immediate mobile debit access while the replacement card is in the mail.

After identifying fraud, customers can choose a digital debit card while they wait for their physical replacement. If they opt in, it is issued right away so they can keep making debit purchases with less disruption.
